description: Updates the text of an existing Trello action (e.g., a comment or card update) identified by `idAction`; this change only affects the action's text content.

idAction.description: The unique identifier of the Trello action (e.g., a comment or card update) whose text needs to be updated.
idAction.title: Id Action

value.description: The new text content for the action. This string must have a length between 1 and 16384 characters, inclusive.
examples: This is the updated comment text with additional details.
value.title: Value
